exposure: oral administration of two different probiotic formulas
cohort: The study included 80 preterm neonates born at a gestational age of less than 32 weeks.
finding: Probiotic supplementation in preterm neonates led to significant differences in microbiota profiles, including lower temporal variation, higher relative abundance of Bifidobacterium and Enterobacter, reduced abundance of Escherichia, Enterococcus, and Klebsiella, and a significantly reduced monthly incidence of necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC).
